summary.text: Vincent Dixie is a Democratic member of the Tennessee House of Representatives for District 54, where he has served since November 2018, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Dixie is the only candidate listed for the District 54 general election.

paragraphs.text: Vincent Dixie was born in Chattanooga, Tennessee.

He earned a high school diploma from Hunters Lane Comprehensive High School, a bachelor's degree from Tennessee State University in 1997, and a graduate degree from Tennessee State University in 2004.

In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, Dixie said he worked in the healthcare industry as an internal auditor for HCA and Ardent Health Services before entering politics, and in 2009 founded two bail bonding companies.
Dixie took office representing District 54 on November 6, 2018.
He also ran in the Democratic primary for Tennessee's 7th Congressional District and lost on August 6, 2026.
In the 2026 survey, he listed affordable housing, a livable wage, and affordable and accessible healthcare as his key campaign messages.
